text.p: ASR Investments Corp said it sold mortgage assets for $13,350,000 and a gain of about $10,950,000, completing its transition to an apartment real estate investment trust.

With the regular cash flows and earlier redemptions, the company has received $14,850,000 from the mortgage assets in the second quarter and $22,350,000 during 1997. It said it will use proceeds to buy apartment communities.

With the sale, ASR has completed a transition to an apartment REIT. Net income in future periods will be cut by higher depreciation expense from additional communities and an absence of income from mortgage assets, but funds from operations will increase substantially, it said.
The higher FFO and the completion of the transition to an apartment REIT are expected to increase stockholders' value.
The company plans to maintain its current dividend and expects that its FFO will support the dividend level.
